APPROVE
The extracted iterators run in the same order and are consumed right away by `AddRange`, so behaviour is unchanged, and `InScript` drops from 26 to about 5. I couldn't find the source file on this machine, so I couldn't confirm that the new parameter types (`Func<Family, bool>`, `IReadOnlyDictionary<string, bool>`, `IReadOnlySet<string>`) match what `GuardBindings`, `Known` and `ReadsGuard` actually use, and the build should confirm that before merging.
